positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Organization: Fuchsia OS
Team: Netstack

Fuchsia is general purpose operating system built by Google. The project is open source (see https://fuchsia.dev/), and currently backs Google Nest Hub suite of smart displays. The Netstack team is responsible for the OS's networking functionality in the Ethernet/Ip/Transport layers. My work is primarily at the Netstack's API layer, providing interfaces for other Fuchsia components to manage and observe the system's networking state. There are two two implementations of the Netstack, and I work on both of them: Netstack2 is the production Netstack written in Go, while Netstack3 is the upcoming replacement written in Rust.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Organization: Google Cloud Platform 
Team: Cloud Interconnect

The Cloud Interconnect team provides customers with a direct physical connection between their on-premise networks and their virtual private cloud. My work wass largely focused on Google's software defined edge network and the virtualization layer between customer's VPCs and the physical network. These are both large scale distributed systems to which I have made improvements to system reliability, scale, and consistency.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: As a teaching assistant I was responsible for grading homework/exams, hosting office hours, and managing course utilities. Through these responsibilities I demonstrated my ability to communicate and interact with a variety of professors and students. The courses I assisted were Object Oriented Design, Algorithms, Operating Systems, and Systems Programming.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: I worked as a research intern within the space of cyber security visual analytics tools. I completed a literature review of research papers within the field, and developed a taxonomy of existing cyber security analytics tools. Using what I learned from this taxonomy, I worked on a team to design and develop a platform to aid research of real-time cyber security analytics. This platform allowed researchers to easily 'stream' historical data as if it were occurring in real time, thus allowing them to more effectively develop tools.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: I developed part of an 'Internet of Things' solution. I was responsible for producing a means of communicating with a micro controller that controlled specific sensors. I created a custom Bluetooth Low Energy profile and implemented it on the DA14580 micro controller, which was connected via SPI to the sensor controller. Using Python, I then created a script that connected to the DA14580 over Bluetooth and uploaded all sensor data to a self-made website. Lastly I created an android app that connected with the DA14580 and performed a series of tests on the connection.

positions.title: Carpenter
positions.description: My primary responsibilities for this position were moving construction materials where necessary, communicating with nearby pedestrians to maintain their safety, and cleaning up the sight to ensure the safety of all employees.
